articleTitle: What Research Says About Postpartum Return to Exercise
imageHeadline: Your 6-Week Checkup Isn't a Green Light to Resume Exercise
imageSubtext: What the research actually says about postpartum movement and recovery
pinTitle: What Research Says About Postpartum Return to Exercise | Evidence-Based Recovery Timeline
pinDescription: The standard 6-week postpartum clearance doesn't tell the whole story about when and how to return to exercise after birth. Understand what the research shows about pelvic floor recovery, tissue healing, and building back strength safely during the postpartum period.
